_about: Embraer EMB-145 (ERJ-145 EP/ER/EU/MP/MK/LR/LU), from Embraer's Airport Planning Manual APM-145/1100, Revision 16 (Nov 29/24): 2.2 Airplane Dimensions (page index 17-18), Figure 2.2.1 EMB-145 Airplane General Dimensions (page index 19: side, plan and front views on one sheet), Figure 2.3.1 Ground Clearances (page index 21-24), Figure 2.7.1 Door Clearances (page index 32-33). Black strokes (layers.py --mode strokes --color 0,0,0), drawn level and to one scale (the 27.93 m fuselage, 29.87 m overall length, 20.04 m span and 7.55 m tailplane agree within 0.6%). Pixels of those rasters at scale 16, line centres. Scaled by the printed 27.93 m fuselage length, nose tip to the tail cone's end. A T-tail (the tailplane on the fin's top fairing) with two AE 3007 nacelles on stub pylons on the rear fuselage, a plain wing tip. The side view's tube is 492 px tall ahead of the wing and 482 px behind it (its belly rises 4 cm), 2.28 m across the middle third as printed; the plan and front draw it 485 and 482 px: no height fit. The side view draws 20 cabin windows (one in the overwing exit), the main door, the overwing exit and the baggage door (left side: Figure 2.7.1's plan); the baggage door's top is behind the nacelle (Figure 2.7.1's 1.00 m height). The right side's service door is Figure 2.7.1's: 0.69 m wide, its middle 6.17 m from the nose, 1.47 m tall, its sill at the main door's. Overwing exits on both sides (Figure 2.7.1 sheet 2's plan).

sources.title: Embraer, EMB-145 Airport Planning Manual (APM-145/1100, Revision 16, Nov 29/24), 2.2 Airplane Dimensions, Figure 2.2.1 EMB-145 Airplane General Dimensions, Figure 2.3.1 Ground Clearances, Figure 2.7.1 Door Clearances
sources.note: Dimensions and outlines read off Figure 2.2.1's side, plan and front views (tools/trace/e145/); the figures are the aircraft's measurements, not a copy of the drawing. The right side's service door is placed from Figure 2.7.1 (its middle 6.17 m from the nose, 0.69 m wide, 1.47 m tall); the baggage door's top, behind the nacelle in the side view, from its 1.00 m height.
